title: Planar Polygon Rings
coordinates: Finite source-space xyz; normalized by common extent before predicates
rings: First outer boundary, remaining disjoint nonnested holes. Either winding accepted. Repeated exact closing endpoint normalized. Collinear and near-collinear intermediate boundary vertices preserved.
result: Triangles retain input vertex indices and outer winding; no inserted vertices
control: Every ring validation, intersection, bridge, ear and coverage step invokes caller work callback. Errors abort atomically.
